_note: The far terraces' pebble tables: one on each of three terraces of the stepped hillside at the island's southern tip, placed by hand on the plate's own earthworks, each with its long side along its terrace; explorer [x, z], metres. half: the paved ground levelled for it; rot: the direction of its long side; ground: the terrace's height; rise: the step up to the terrace above. landing: the small landing below the terraces on the south-west shore, where couriers' boats put in: a quay (`at`, `rot` the direction of its long side along the shore, `half`, `top` above the sea; its sea face on the shoreline, inside the island's southernmost point so the model's bounding box stays put), and a stair from the lowest earthwork terrace (`stair.top`, at `stair.h`) down to the quay's back edge.
